name: Nova
source: Virgil’s most trusted general tasked with creating a safety net around Virgil’s empire. If his intrigues ever fail, Nova and her gang will be the first line of defense. Despite her commanding aura, Nova tends to be quite friendly as long as you don’t piss her off. She especially likes people who are arrogant enough to challenge her, mostly because she enjoys putting them in their place.
